snippet.title: Do You even Forklift? - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2476650/Do_You_even_Forklift/
Wishlist on PS store:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014377

When all you have is a Forklift, everything looks like palete.
Take a flight to Ghibli stylized JAPAN!
Let your forklift loose on a peacefull prefecture

Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Ghibli and Japaniese car culture! 
Use your foklift skills in logic puzzles with many unexpected outcomes!

Steam/ PS4 /PS5 / Xbox x|s /Nintendo Switch

My Discord server: https://discord.gg/3c737xGJx3

0:00 - Forklift someware in Japan
0:06 - place color cars on parking spot. Becarefull with alarm!
0:12 - that’s REAL evil forklift
0:17 - cars can be EV and wired
0:22 - unlock new 
0:26 - be smart about color sensitive gates
0:36 - use illegal moves
0:39 - not only on parking
0:40 - help the world
0:42 - and cook big ramen
0:45 - Please WISHLIST on Steam!

#indiegame #gaming #cozygames #forklift #indiegameswtf
